# AttributeError when importing pydantic: 'ModuleSpec' object has no attribute '__parent'

## Description

I'm getting an AttributeError when trying to import pydantic in my project. The error occurs during the initialization of the pydantic module.

```
AttributeError: 'ModuleSpec' object has no attribute '__parent'. Did you mean: 'parent'?
```

This happens on line 259 of `pydantic/__init__.py` where it's trying to set up dynamic imports for `PlainSerializer`.

## Steps to reproduce

Simply trying to import pydantic in a Python script will trigger this error:

```python
import pydantic  # This fails with the AttributeError
```

Or even just running Python and importing:

```
>>> import pydantic
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
  File "/path/to/pydantic/__init__.py", line 259, in <module>
    'PlainSerializer': (__spec__.__parent, '.functional_serializers'),
AttributeError: 'ModuleSpec' object has no attribute '__parent'. Did you mean: 'parent'?
```

I believe this is a typo in the code where `__parent` is used instead of `parent` (without the double underscores). The error message even suggests this correction.

This is blocking me from using pydantic in my project. I'm using the latest version from the main branch.
